cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

mechanism: A leads a failed treasure search, adapts torch use to B constraint and turns each failed approach into a different secret mission acted on immediately.
confusable: Unlike insisting the original goal is succeeding, A replaces treasure with waking, listening and breath training.
comparison: Dark-wall exploration differs from a ship report becoming entertainment and rejection training.
seedUse: D161-a wall map, fading torch and audible breath; S02-a accepts resource limits and offers physical reassurance.
